_readme: MANUAL OVERRIDE FILE. This beats every other source: overrides > /api/live >
completed matches > schedule.json > TBD.
Edit this file on github.com from your phone. The sync Action redeploys the site,
so a correction is live in about a minute with no code change.
Everything here is optional. An empty object for each key is the normal state.
series  — keyed by Series.id. OpenDota series are "s-<series_id>" (e.g. "s-1130328");
schedule.json rows use whatever id you gave them. Any subset of the Series
fields is merged on top of the computed one. Most useful:
"scoreA", "scoreB", "winnerId", "status", "startUtc", "roundLabel"
Slots are set with an object: "a": { "kind": "team", "teamId": 2163 }
Setting a winnerId does NOT auto-set the score — set both.
swiss   — keyed by team id as a string. Fields: wins, losses, state.
state is one of: active | advanced | elimination_round | eliminated
hide    — array of Series ids to remove from the site entirely (remade series,
duplicate rows, bad data).
syncState — force the status dot: "ok" | "degraded" | "manual". Use "manual" when you
are hand-driving the site so the page stops claiming it is auto-synced.
championId — set the champion directly, e.g. 7119388. Wins over anything computed.
streamUrl — replace the stream link everywhere.
EXAMPLE (delete the leading underscore from a key to activate it):
"series": { "s-1130328": { "scoreA": 1, "scoreB": 2, "winnerId": 9467224 } },
"swiss": { "2586976": { "state": "eliminated" } },
